senses.gloss:
√bhaṣ 'bark'
present: [1.] bhaṣati etc. E.+ bhaṣate etc. 
[perfect: babhāṣa abhāṣīt bhaṣiṣyati bhaṣitā ]
verbal: bhaṣitum 
derivatives: bhaṣá bhaṣaka C. bhaṣaṇa C. -bhāṣ? AB.

√bhas 'devour'
present: [3.] bábhasti bápsati etc. babhasat babdhām -- bhásat bhasáthas 
verbal: bhasita 
derivatives: bhas -bhasa? E. bhástrā? B.+ bhásman V.+ -psu RV. babhasa U. 
Compare the derived root psā. The nounds bhasád V.B.S., bháṅsas V. hardly belong here.

√bhāṣ 'speak'
present: [1.] bhāṣate etc. B.+ bhāṣati etc. E.+ 
perfect: babhāṣe etc. B.+ 
aorist: [1.] abhāṣi -- [3.] ababhāṣat abībhaṣat -- [5.] abhāṣiṣi 
future: [1.] bhāṣiṣyate -- [2.] bhāṣitā 
verbal: bhāṣita E.+ bhāṣitum U.+ bhāṣṭum bhāṣitvā -bhāṣya E.+ 
secondary: passive: bhāṣyate etc. E.+ -- intensive: bābhāṣ- -- desiderative: bibhāṣiṣa- -- causative: bhāṣayati etc. E.+ bhāṣayate etc. 
derivatives: -bhāṣ -bhāṣa E.+ bhāṣā S.+ bhāṣaka C. bhāṣin E. bhāṣya S.+ bhāṣaṇa E.+ -bhāṣaṇīya C. bhāṣitavya E. bhā́ṣitṛ B.+ 
Related with roots bhā, bhās, bhan.

√bhās 'shine'
present: [1.] bhā́sati etc. AV.+ bhā́sate etc. E.+ 
perfect: babhāse etc. E.+ 
[aorist: ababhāsat abībhasat abhāsiṣṭa bhāsiṣyate bhāsitā ]
verbal: bhāsita 
secondary: intensive: bābhās- -- desiderative: bibhāsiṣa- -- causative: bhāsayati etc. U.+ bhāsayate bhāsyate 
derivatives: bhās E.+ bhāsá B.+ bhāsaka C. bhāsin E.+ bhāsya C. -bhāsana E.+ bhā́sas RV. bhāsura E. bhāsvará B.+ 
Doubtless a secondary root-form from √bhā, perhaps through the noun bhā́s. Compare also √bhāṣ.
